metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

semantics.identity_rule: Each conversation has an explicit identity.
semantics.message_rule: Messages reference conversation identity; conversation is not derived from message order.
semantics.transport_rule: Conversation survives connection replacement according to application policy.
semantics.owner_rule: Group owner semantics are explicit and immutable where declared.
semantics.authority_rule: Conversation membership only grants messaging rights declared by messaging policy.

invariants.rule: Listener, route, endpoint, connection, channel, peer reachability and cryptographic transport evidence never by themselves grant application, data or operation authority.
Inbound network data remains inert until explicit protocol parsing, validation, identity/context resolution, authorization and dispatcher routing succeed.

hard_gates.condition: messages with same participants merged heuristically
group owner inferred from first online peer
conversation id reused as transport session
